title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for the rest mass m must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The application of conservation of energy must be correctly stated and utilized in the solution.

title: Momentum Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The application of conservation of momentum must be correctly stated and utilized in the solution.

title: Correct Use of Gamma
description: Important Criteria: The definition and use of the Lorentz factor gamma must be correctly applied in the context of the problem.

title: Algebraic Manipulation
description: Optional Criteria: The algebraic steps to eliminate E and derive the final expression must be clear and correct.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The units used throughout the solution must be consistent and correctly applied.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes or incorrect assumptions about the direction of momentum must be avoided.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The solution should consider and discuss limiting cases, such as low velocities.
